name: General practice clinics
title: Clear answers and easier appointments for patients
problem: Patients often need help quickly, but finding a doctor they trust is hard, and long queues and waiting lists make it harder.
asks: Can I get a checkup today or this week?
How do I book an appointment?
worries: Trust in the doctor and the facility
services: Clinic website with proof and fast replies
lead: We build a clinic website that shows your experience and facility clearly, and makes booking an appointment quick.
note: Medical advertising rules apply. A doctor should check this page before it goes live.

name: Dental clinics
title: Dental care you can book without the wait
problem: Patients want a face-to-face checkup with a dentist they feel comfortable with, and they are often unsure what their problem is or how serious it is.
asks: Can I get a routine checkup?
Do you treat cavities, broken teeth or jaw injuries?
What causes yellowing, and what can be done?
Do you offer implants, braces and oral surgery?
worries: Meeting the dentist in person before treatment
services: Photo intake for the dentist to review before booking
lead: Patients can send photos and symptoms before they visit. The dentist reviews them and decides the next step.
note: Dental advertising rules apply. A dentist should check this page before it goes live.

name: Restaurants and cafes
title: More visitors, more orders, more reviews
problem: Guests want to know the food is good and what goes into it. Many people who eat with you never leave a review.
asks: What is on the menu, and what are the prices?
Do you deliver or do takeaway?
worries: Few reviews from people who have eaten here
proof: Menu and ingredients on the website
Photos of the food and the space
lead: After a visit, every guest is asked for a review, so reviews come from all customers. Your menu is clear online, so more people come in.

name: Hotels and guest houses
title: Guests who know exactly what they are booking
problem: Guests compare prices across many sites and want to know which room they will get before they book.
asks: What is the price, and what is included?
What are check-in and check-out times?
worries: Not knowing what the room looks like
Trust that the booking will be honoured
lead: Guests see your rooms, prices and location clearly, and can book directly with you.

name: Salons and spas
title: Fuller chairs, even in slow seasons
problem: Clients want to know prices and whether a stylist is free before they travel. Slow seasons leave chairs empty.
asks: Is a stylist free right now?
Can I get a particular haircut?
worries: Waiting time when the salon is busy
services: Offer messages to customers who agreed to receive them
lead: We help fill slow weeks with ads and offers, and show whether a stylist is free before a client travels.
note: Offer messages go only to customers who have agreed to receive them.

name: Gyms and fitness studios
title: Members who start and keep going
problem: People who try a gym often do not join, and members who stop after a few months are hard to win back.
asks: Do you have trainers, and what are their certificates?
Can I try it before joining?
lead: Members get reminders, plan updates and a clear trial process, so they keep coming back.
note: Diet plans must be checked by a qualified dietitian or trainer before members follow them.

name: Coaching institutes and tuition
title: Parents who trust the teaching
problem: Parents want to see the teachers, batch timings and results before they enrol, and admissions slow down at exam time.
worries: Whether the fees are worth it
services: Teacher hiring page with online applications
Doubt assistant that passes unsolved doubts to teachers
lead: Parents see the teaching, the batches and the teachers clearly. Students get help with doubts between classes.

name: Schools and playschools
title: Parents who choose you before the admission rush
problem: Parents compare schools on facilities, curriculum and safety, and a weak online presence loses them to better-known schools.
worries: How the child will settle in
lead: Parents see the facilities and curriculum clearly, and can enquire easily before the admission rush.

name: Real estate agents and brokers
title: Listings that reach the right buyers
problem: Buyers do not trust agents and want to speak directly to the owner. Good listings often get too few views.
asks: What is the price and the possession date?
Can I speak to the owner directly?
worries: Not knowing who they are dealing with
lead: Your listings reach the right buyers, and buyers can see which documents are available before they visit.
note: Buyers should check legal title with a lawyer. We do not verify legal title.

name: Builders and contractors
title: Clients who trust the quote and the timeline
problem: Clients compare prices, want to know what materials will be used, and worry about delays and hidden costs.
asks: What is the cost per square foot?
lead: Clients see your past work and an honest timeline and costing before they commit.

name: Interior designers
title: Clients who see the style before they call
problem: Good work does not always reach the right clients, and clients want examples of what they will get before they hire.
asks: What will it cost for my budget?
What styles do you work in?
How long will the project take?
worries: Whether the design fits the space
services: Gallery of examples by style and budget
lead: Clients see examples that match their style and budget before they get in touch.

name: Lawyers and legal practices
title: The right lawyer for your case
problem: People often consult the wrong type of lawyer, or pick a lawyer with a big title for a small task they cannot afford.
asks: Are there options other than court?
services: Practice website with clear practice areas
lead: Visitors find the right lawyer for their case and share their details in confidence.
note: Advertising by advocates is governed by Bar Council of India rules. A lawyer must check this page before it goes live. This page does not give legal advice.

name: Chartered accountants and tax consultants
title: Deadlines handled, records in order
problem: Clients miss deadlines because they do not know what to file or when. They worry about penalties and about who is handling their data.
asks: What do I need to file?
Can you handle GST, audit or company setup?
lead: Clients know what to file and when it is due, and how their records are kept secure.
note: Chartered accountants' advertising is governed by ICAI rules. Check this page against them before it goes live.

name: Local retail shops
title: Customers who know you are open and what you have
problem: Customers do not know your timings or whether you have what they need, so footfall falls.
asks: Do you have this in stock?
worries: Whether the shop has what they need
services: Shop website with stock and timings
lead: Customers see your timings, location and what you have before they visit.
note: Show only stock that is kept up to date.

name: Online sellers and e-commerce brands
title: Lower ad costs and more repeat buyers
problem: Ads are expensive, competition is high, and marketplace commissions take a large share. Repeat buyers are hard to track.
proof: Return rate (if you choose to share it)
lead: We help you sell on your own website too, with ads that bring the right buyers and a way to bring them back.

name: Manufacturers and B2B suppliers
title: Buyers who find you first
problem: Buyers compare suppliers on lead times, certifications and price, and competitors often reach them first.
asks: Can I get a price estimate?
lead: Buyers find you first and see your certifications and lead times clearly.

name: Event planners
title: Clients with the right budget for their event
problem: Enquiries often come from budgets too small for the plans, and clients are unhappy when the setup they got elsewhere does not match what they expected.
asks: Which venues do you work with?
How long do you need to arrange the event?
worries: Whether the price is worth it
services: Vendor price comparison (with vendors who agree)
lead: Clients see packages and what they include, so they choose the right budget for their event.

name: Photographers and videographers
title: A portfolio the right clients can find
problem: Good work does not reach the clients who would pay for it, and clients want to know delivery time and style before they book.
asks: What style do you shoot in?
lead: Clients find work in their category and send an enquiry in a few clicks.

name: Travel agencies and tour operators
title: Clear itineraries that turn enquiries into bookings
problem: Travellers compare too many agencies, and enquiries come in before venues and food are finalised.
services: Hotel price comparison for destinations we do not partner with
lead: Travellers see clear itineraries and what is included, so enquiries turn into bookings.
note: Do not promise safety, or inclusions that depend on vendors we do not control.

name: Auto garages and service centres
title: Vehicles booked in, customers who trust the bill
problem: Owners worry about overcharging, delays and whether they will get genuine parts, so they often choose big brands instead.
services: Parts page explaining genuine and replacement parts
lead: Owners book in online, see the process, and know what they are paying for.
